# React Dashboard UI

- Use functional components.
- Keep API calls in service modules.
- Include loading, empty, error, and success states.
- Use responsive Tailwind layouts.
- Verify mobile and desktop behavior.
- Avoid storing secrets or refresh tokens in browser storage.
